hard_rules: Do not promote to RL unless baseline and broader validation pass.
Do not tune PPO or rewards to rescue weak signals.
Do not run live trading or broker execution.
Do not delete or overwrite historical results.
Do not start a new thesis while run_lock.json is locked.
Use E211 as incumbent benchmark until displaced by executable validation.
Do not treat TB11 options results as deployable before robustness and tail audit.
Do not promote TB11 until the selected maturity-adjusted profile is frozen into an explicit paper-trading specification and execution-readiness checklist.
Do not paper/live trade TB11 without the itemized Indian F&O charge module enabled and reviewed against current broker schedules.
Phase 1 and Phase 2 must not place broker orders; they are logging and paper-price validation only.
Tiny live one-lot validation requires explicit future human approval after dry-run and paper-price gates pass.
